svg.text: FG-D1 / Cubics and the ends of a graph
ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Inspect the roots and both ends.
A cubic can have three distinct real roots.
Here x²+1 is always positive, so only x=0 is
Degree and leading sign agree in both cases; the number of distinct real roots differs.
